verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs state the parity claim directly: "Anything you can do in the Flagsmith dashboard, you can also do via the Admin API." They also say the Admin API covers creating, updating and deleting projects, environments, flags, segments and users, and the official MCP server and CLI are built on that same Admin API. The probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard docs paths, which makes the API harder to discover but does not contradict parity. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that UI-only features (e.g. release pipelines, experimentation, change requests) are API-reachable, and a discoverable OpenAPI spec.
